item.title: 2004 Radical SR3 Supersport 1500 & Trailer at No Reserve
item.description: This 2004 Radical SR3 Supersport is a left-hand-drive example that is powered by a 1,500cc Powertec-Suzuki Hayabusa inline-four linked with a six-speed sequential transaxle and a Quaife gear-drive unit. item.title: 1941 Chrysler Thunderbolt-Style Children’s Ride at No Reserve
item.description: This children’s ride is said to be one of 10 built in the style of a 1941 Chrysler Thunderbolt concept car, featuring a red fiberglass body over a black steel base and powered by a coin-activated electric motor. Additional features include a beige padded seat, a three-spoke steering wheel, faux wheels with whitewall tires, silver-finished bumpers and side trim, a faux windscreen, and a speaker system that plays simulated horn noises as well as the song “In the Mood". item.title: 2006 Saab 9-5 Sedan 2.3T at No Reserve
item.description: This 2006 Saab 9-5 2.3T sedan has 58k miles following registration history in New York and Pennsylvania. It is powered by a turbocharged 2.3-liter inline-four linked with a five-speed Sentronic automatic transaxle and is finished in Steel Gray Metallic over Slate Gray leather upholstery. Equipment includes a sunroof, 17" split-spoke alloy wheels, heated power-adjustable front seats, a left rear seat heater, a CD stereo, cruise control, and automatic climate control. item.title: 1992 Ford Mustang GT Hatchback 5-Speed
item.description: This 1992 Ford Mustang GT hatchback was registered in Texas, Florida, and Colorado before its August 2022 acquisition by the seller, and it is finished in white over Titanium leather. item.title: 1981 Porsche 928 5-Speed
item.description: This 1981 Porsche 928 is a Canadian-market example that reportedly remained in storage from 1984 to 2021, and recommissioning work in 2023 included replacing the timing belt, water pump, tires, radiator, vacuum hoses, and drive belts. Finished in Platinum Metallic over brown leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 4.5-liter V8 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 40-Years-Owned 1936 Ford Model 68 Deluxe Woodie Station Wagon
item.description: This 1936 Ford Model 68 is one of 7,044 Deluxe woodie wagons produced for the model year and is said to have been initially purchased by the La Quinta Resort of Palm Springs, California. It was subsequently owned by Early Ford V-8 Club of America president Joe Price, Jr., before being purchased by the seller in 1985. item.title: 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Project at No Reserve
item.description: This 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT was sold new through Stoddard Imports of Highland Heights, Ohio. Following time in storage, chassis AR614537 underwent mechanical work under previous ownership in the mid-2010s before being sold on BaT in November 2017. The car was subsequently dismantled as part of a planned project begun in 2018 that was featured as a BaT success story in June 2018. item.title: 1994 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 Widebody 5-Speed
item.description: This 1994 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 is one of 267 factory widebody coupes delivered to the North American market.
